rules.logic: BIOC(Roles Anywhere Trust Anchor Created or Repointed to External CA) AND BIOC(Roles Anywhere CreateSession Minting STS Credentials From Unmanaged Trust Anchor) on the same AWS account within 60m — stitches the attacker-controlled CA registration to the first certificate-minted STS session, evidencing a durable certificate-backed persistence substrate rather than a one-off key use.
rules.name: Roles Anywhere Certificate-Backed Persistence Establishment Chain

rules.logic: Fires when a Prisma Cloud / Cortex Cloud posture finding flags an IAM role whose trust policy has Principal.Service rolesanywhere.amazonaws.com with an empty Condition, AND BIOC(Roles Anywhere CreateSession Minting STS Credentials From Unmanaged Trust Anchor) observes a runtime CreateSession minting credentials against that same role ARN within 24h — the CSPM-to-runtime pivot proving the unconditioned trust policy was exercised, not merely present.
rules.name: Unconditioned Roles Anywhere Trust Policy Exploited From Posture Finding to Runtime Session
